notes.title: Preparing for first release after recreating it from 0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
It's been a while since I made a post here, but last year I decided, after learning more, to revive (no matter what) the game. 

Now I know a lot more about games, releasing games, game dev and more, so I feel more prepared now than ever.

I already finished the in-game computer - from where you can buy parts. I also added an app "Apps Hub" from where you can install/uninstall apps that you will later need in the game, depending on what you are doing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904481/d860befff8e63129f87e2b9154d93038ef1e35a7.jpg[/img]

I also worked on the assembly mechanic, but it's not finished yet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904481/fa3f1eb9840958d50dffae790eef6c5848b8db0b.jpg[/img]

I hope for a release of the new version before June this year.

And I will also try to make either a devlog every 2 weeks (or so), or post announcements like this one.

Thanks everyone who supported me! And also to those who didn't, you feedback motivated me even more :)
